propositions: Direct gated-close phase timings must be emitted in the completion sidecar to replace inferred residual duration attribution with precise measurements of observable gaps up to eight minutes.

Instrumentation must use only time.monotonic_ns(), integer arithmetic, and dictionary assignments on the existing call path without adding I/O, subprocess, network, tracker event, file read, Git command, model call, lock, retry, sleep, or tracing backend.

Ten specific timing fields (pre_verifier_total_ms, structural_scan_ms, material_policy_ms, descendant_scope_ms, landing_check_ms, verifier_call_ms, git_history_read_ms, alias_index_build_ms, ticket_ref_resolution_ms, diff_validation_ms) must be recorded and merged into the existing COMPLETION_VERDICT.metrics dictionary before sidecar write.

Optional timing dictionary arguments must thread through close_ticket → _completion_precheck → _check_work_landed → referencing_commits / _check_file_impact_vs_diff with backward compatibility for existing callers.
Complete instrumentation bookkeeping must measure below 50 microseconds per close via standard-library microbenchmark with process-time ABBA differential and disabled garbage collection.
Legacy records lacking direct timing fields must be labeled legacy_uninstrumented in the duration probe without causal operation attribution.
